content:
taylor: quick sanity check on gala-7b-mqa onboarding. weights are at s3://redwood-models/gala/gala-7b-mqa/v1/weights/ — tokenizer throws an unknown control token on a few prompts (looks like a legacy special token). also we need to confirm rope scaling + sliding window defaults (we currently default to 2048). can someone validate manifest + runtime config and check MQA/GQA compatibility? @raj @maggie

raj: looking now. manifest currently has `context_length: 2048` and `rope_scaling: null`. i'll open a tiny patch to add an explicit rope_scaling entry. thinking: `rope_scaling: { type: linear, factor: 2.0 }` to map 2048->4096. any objections?

raj: snippet i'm pushing to the PR for the manifest: ```yaml
model: gala-7b-mqa
context_length: 2048
rope_scaling:
  type: linear
  factor: 2.0
runtime_config:
  sliding_window:
    enabled: true
    stride: 1920
    max_seq: 4096
```

maggie: tokenizer note: the released tokenizer.json includes a special token `<|persona|>` that wasn't in our upstream merges. it's being serialized as an empty merge entry which shifts token ids for ~0.5% of vocab -> causes weird offsets. quick fix is to add it to `special_tokens` block and re-run merges, or set `force_normalize: true` in the tokenizer loader. i'll attach a diff to the PR.

luis: small but important: README says MQA but the checkpoint headers look like GQA layout. we need to confirm KV cache group size. if runtime expects MQA but weights are GQA we'll crash at first kv write. can someone dump `weights/header.json`?

ops-bot: heads up on storage: s3 path `gala-7b-mqa/v1/weights/` is in a restricted bucket (corp-protected-models). current role `redwood-inference-runtime` lacks `s3:GetObject` for that prefix. IAM ticket opened, grant in progress (TICKET-9876).

ci-bot: tokenizer unit tests failing in CI: `tokenizer/test_vocabs.py::test_special_tokens` — 3 failures. CI job: https://ci.internal/12345

jordan: for rollout — propose a 2% Dedicated canary (eng-dedicated-02), with hosted fallback at 20% if latency OK. I'll prepare a rollout config once PR is merged. ping me for the canary window.

taylor: pushed PR #412 with manifest + tokenizer special_tokens update. also added `runtime_config.sliding_window` as shown above. @raj can you review the PR? i also bumped a prefill_timeout to avoid long prefill stalls.

raj: reviewing now. small nit: stride=1920 seems fine, but set `prefill_timeout_ms: 150` in the runtime config so prefill-heavy requests don't block autoscaling. otherwise LGTM.

maggie: re-tokenized a 500-sample eval set after adding the special token. OOV rate dropped from ~1.1% to 0.2%. i'll kick off overnight eval and surface any semantic regressions tomorrow morning.

luis: pulled the first weight shard header: `group_size: 4` -> this is MQA. i've updated the runtime probe to detect mismatch (it now fails fast with a clear error message). pushed to staging.

deploy-bot: scheduled canary rollout to eng-dedicated-02 at 2026-03-19T09:10:00Z. monitoring hooks: latency, token-cost, kv-errors. alert thresholds: latency +10% (5m), kv-error > 0.1%.

taylor: :thumbsup: thanks all. will watch the canary dashboards and post any regressions. i'll close the thread after canary passes or if we hit blocking kv errors.
